traceability.notes: All functional acceptance criteria for docs/stories/025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION.story.md are implemented and verified. The plugin now (1) detects CatchClause annotations both before the catch keyword and as the first comments inside the catch body, with a clear precedence for before-catch comments, (2) falls back correctly when getCommentsInside is missing or empty, (3) places auto-fix annotations inside the catch block at a Prettier-stable position, (4) passes real Prettier+ESLint integration tests, and (5) documents these behaviors in the user-facing API reference. All relevant unit, rule-level, and integration tests pass, and existing branch behavior for other constructs remains intact. Therefore this story is fully implemented and passes.
